open: In the name of Allah. Assalamu alaikum, my dears. Come closer, tonight’s story is very beautiful.
s1a: Noah, Ilyas, have you ever received news so surprising that you could hardly believe it? Tonight I’ll tell you about news like that, brought by very special guests, announcing a child nobody was expecting anymore.
s1c: Get warm and cosy, my dears… Tonight I’ll tell you about the Prophet Ishaq, peace be upon him, the son of Ibrahim and the younger brother of Ismail.
s2a: Ibrahim and his wife Sarah lived in a blessed land. Ibrahim had a son, Ismail, far away in the valley of Makkah. But Sarah had not had a child, and they had both become very old.
s2c: The Qur’an doesn’t tell us that, my dear, and what we don’t know, we don’t make up. But we know for sure that Ibrahim always trusted Allah, and that nothing is impossible for Allah.
s3a: One day, guests came to Ibrahim; “they said, ‘Peace.’ He said, ‘Peace.’” “Then he went to his family and came with a fat calf, and placed it near them; he said, ‘Will you not eat?’”
s3b: But they did not eat. “And he felt from them apprehension. They said, ‘Fear not.’” “We have been sent to the people of Lut.” They were angels.
s3d: Yes, my dear. And now listen carefully: “And his wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Ishaq and after Ishaq, Yaqub.”
s4a: “And his wife approached with a cry and struck her face,” and she said: “Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing.”
s4b: A very old woman having a baby? Is that possible?
s4c: The angels said: “Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house.” When Allah wills something, it happens, and nothing is impossible for Him.
s4d: Ibrahim was amazed too: “Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me?” They said: “We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing.” He said: “And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?”
s5a: And Allah’s promise came true: Sarah had a boy, Ishaq. And Ibrahim prayed: “Praise to Allah, who has granted to me in old age Ismail and Ishaq. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.”
s5c: Yes, Ismail and Ishaq, and both became prophets. “And We gave him good tidings of Ishaq, a prophet from among the righteous. And We blessed him and Ishaq.”
s6a: And Allah praises Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaqub: “those of strength and vision. Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home of the Hereafter.” “And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah.”
s6b: And Yaqub? Did he come, like the angels said?
s6c: Yes! Ishaq had a son, Yaqub, who became a prophet, and Yaqub’s son Yusuf was a prophet too. Our Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: “The noble, son of the noble, son of the noble, son of the noble: Yusuf, son of Yaqub, son of Ishaq, son of Ibrahim.”
s6d: Four prophets in a row, like a chain!
s6e: Like a shining chain, my dear. Many prophets came from the descendants of Ishaq, and from the descendants of Ismail came our Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him. And all of them believed in the one God.
s7a: They’ve fallen asleep… My dears, never despair of Allah’s mercy, for nothing is impossible for Allah. When Allah gives you something good, say like Ibrahim: Alhamdulillah. And be like Ishaq: do good, pray, and give to others.
s7b: And next time, I’ll tell you about Yaqub… and about the important question he asked his sons at the end of his life. And you, watching us right now: if you liked the story, ask your parents to subscribe to our channel, so you don’t miss the next story.
close: And you, dear fathers and mothers: subscribe to our channel, and share these stories with the people you love, so that together we pass on the beautiful message of Islam to our children.
final: Good night, my dears. I entrust you to Allah, with whom nothing entrusted is ever lost.
